ngaap.notes: Vulcan's EBITDA bridge starts at net earnings (2021 Q3+: net earnings attributable to Vulcan) and adds back income tax, interest expense and the loss (earnings) on discontinued operations NET OF TAX before DDA&A, so published EBITDA is continuing-ops EBITDA; the schema check ni_vulcan+ebitda_bridge_tax+interest+total_dda=ebitda_pub therefore differs by ebitda_bridge_disc_ops (extra field, value as added); including it the check ties. adj_items.disc_ops is null (disc ops is not an EBITDA->Adjusted EBITDA item). Adjusted EPS bridge: 'Items included in Adjusted EBITDA above' is the after-tax per-share effect of all EBITDA adjustments. Business development = non-routine acquisition charges incl. purchase-accounting inventory step-up -> adj_items.acquisition; COVID-19 direct incremental costs -> adj_items.other. Q3-21: U.S. Concrete (USCR) acquired 26-Aug-2021. Business development 24.7 includes USCR acquisition-related expenses of 21.1 and purchase-accounting inventory step-up of 3.0 (footnote). COVID costs include 3.0 vaccination incentive program. Restructuring 3.5. Bridge now starts at 'Net earnings attributable to Vulcan'. ROIC TTM 14.2%.
